normalizations: Sweden Central (swedencentral) maps unambiguously to region identifier swedencentral.
The selected minimal cost-monitoring label maps to canonical minimal; budget-only cost monitoring and continuing operational alerts retain their original meaning.
interpretation_constraints: Daily users and concurrency are dev planning ranges, not measured usage or precise point estimates.
USD 500–2,000/month is a soft planning range, not an exact USD 2,000 cap, a price estimate or spend authorization.
Under-two-second typical API responses, RTO within 4 hours and RPO up to 1 hour are objectives to validate, not verified platform capabilities.
No Production SLA is captured. Standard recovery does not imply the runbook profile's 99.9% SLA.

Minimal monitoring does not remove operational alerts. Budget notices use Owner-role recipients and may not reach a named non-Owner; no recipient, role membership, delivery or existing monitoring configuration is verified.
Employees and external Volunteers are distinct sign-in populations; only fictional dev accounts are in scope. No workforce-only identity architecture is selected.
Secure remote-access intent is captured, not a VPN, gateway, ingress, DNS or other network design.
authority_scope: Infrastructure-only dev MVP discovery and authorized anonymous Step 1 documentation/checks/review. No live Azure reads/writes, deployment, credentials, spend or Production authority.
